title: Screen P112 tetrad coefficient fusion under relaxed rank ceilings
body:
## Summary

This source-bound P112 audit composes the fourteen fused tetrad updates through the selected gauge44 centre consumer. It checks hybrid pre-`B` placement, inverse-transpose retiming after `B`, source-side dirty correction, and the candidate frame joins. The selected κ remains `0.001672660197076918`; no frontier update is claimed.

## Scope and limits

For each tetrad, `U K = (U E) E^T` changes four terms from copy rank 2 to rank 1. The pre-`B` hybrid reader and dirty-baseline correction satisfy `H^T d + C^T d = S^T d` and `H^T U K = S^T K`; their supports are 225 and 152 coefficients, a net increase of 201 incidences over the original 176-add cut. At the post-`B` boundary, the original cut retimes to 448 coefficients. A native frame audit finds 120 candidate rank-1 joins to the shared frame. The three-block one-pass sensitivity is `0.002797088144`; it excludes restoration and dirty-baseline execution.

An input-side correction `Jx`, with `J = C^T U K`, avoids requiring the original dirty baseline at the consumer. Its support is 64/96/192/288 for the 3/5/9/14-block prefixes. The corresponding incidence-only sensitivities are `0.004756582174`, `0.011073245628`, `0.020601886496` and `0.029934752880`. These are planning sensitivities, not scalar tariffs or admitted suppliers. The source, schedule, frame/value lifetime, dirty-state handling, restoration and complete outer invoice remain unproved. The scoped completion census also finds no unimodular completion that preserves the original reader without a correction.

## Test plan

Replayed with CPython 3.12:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/p112-tetrad-dual-anchor-screen/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-tetrad-dual-anchor-screen --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-tetrad-dual-anchor-screen
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-tetrad-cut-consumer --check-only
python3.12 research/p112-tetrad-cut-consumer/verify.py
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-tetrad-cut-consumer
```

The checkers pin the selected archive and native recipes; verify all fourteen blocks, dirty-state identities, exact retiming, frame labels, candidate joins and correction supports; and reject coefficient mutations. No changed native schedule or full selected cold replay is claimed.

Package sources and hashes are in `research/p112-tetrad-dual-anchor-screen/SOURCES.json` and `research/p112-tetrad-cut-consumer/SOURCES.json`; package bases are `ebd6b92c43239d76b1a59e29f574563494388f6a` and `b1ef0a5585418590320806c967383584c645132b`. Canonical `main` at submission refresh was `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`.
